reference.inspection: actual pixels inspected; characters arranged by personality type, not a building reference

translation: Apply its angular silhouettes, simple polygonal planes, grouped colours and restrained ground shadows to recognizable facility modules. Do not insert characters as a substitute for facilities.
geometry: Simplified functional details such as vessels, roof vents, loading bays and greenhouse frames
Compose modules rather than generating a complex whole campus in one call
materials: Light and dark planes communicate depth
Avoid photorealistic textures and glossy toy materials
review: Geometry change verified separately from materials
No completion implied by asset appearance
fidelity: requires output-by-output visual review; not guaranteed by palette application
